svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Component · Output actions · share · narrow
svg.desc: Mirrors GalleryPreviewPanel.outputSection's button row (App/GalleryPreviewPanel.swift, .inspector style, macOS item view 2026-09-13) — the OUTPUT group at the foot of the Gallery item view's inspector: what comes of the project. A Photo capture: Share project alone, full width — one photo has nothing to blend, so New clip is left out (the rule the pane's action grid applies). The same actionButton the pane's action grid uses: 57 pt tall, radius 9, primary at 7 %, a 16 pt medium glyph over an 11 pt medium label, 8 pt apart, equal widths across the 302 pt column. The BLENDED CLIPS header, filter and list that follow are the screen's own (blend-list-filter + blended-clip-row components). See components/README.md.
